unit: H177 - addenda and corrections on locked clinical records

A signed record is never edited: what is.ar: السجل الموقّع لا يُعدَّل: ما يُعرف لاحقًا أو يتبيّن خطؤه يُضاف هنا مؤرخًا وموقّعًا.
A signed record is never edited: what is.en: A signed record is never edited: what is learned or found wrong afterwards is added here, dated and signed.
A signed record is never edited: what is.fr: Un dossier signé n'est jamais modifié : ce qui est appris ou corrigé ensuite est ajouté ici, daté et signé.

Add an addendum or a correction.en: Add an addendum or a correction
Add an addendum or a correction.fr: Ajouter un addendum ou une correction

It is kept beside the signed record, wit.ar: تُحفظ بجانب السجل الموقّع باسمك ووقتها، ولا يمكن تعديلها أو حذفها.
It is kept beside the signed record, wit.en: It is kept beside the signed record, with your name and the time; it cannot be edited or deleted.
It is kept beside the signed record, wit.fr: Il est conservé à côté du dossier signé, avec votre nom et l'heure ; il ne peut être ni modifié ni supprimé.

Sign and add this to the record? It cann.ar: هل توقّع وتضيف هذا إلى السجل؟ لا يمكن تعديله أو حذفه بعد ذلك.
Sign and add this to the record? It cann.en: Sign and add this to the record? It cannot be edited or deleted afterwards.
Sign and add this to the record? It cann.fr: Signer et ajouter au dossier ? Il ne pourra plus être modifié ni supprimé.

This record is not signed yet: edit it i.ar: هذا السجل غير موقّع بعد: عدّله نفسه
This record is not signed yet: edit it i.en: This record is not signed yet: edit it itself
This record is not signed yet: edit it i.fr: Ce dossier n'est pas encore signé : modifiez-le directement

A correction says why the record was wro.en: A correction says why the record was wrong
A correction says why the record was wro.fr: Une correction indique pourquoi le dossier était erroné
